# Name Part Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NamePartType`](gmeow-NamePartType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NamePartType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a name part (given, surname, patronymic, particle, Arabic nisba, filename extension, …). A value, not a [`NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md) subclass: naming systems worldwide contribute an open-ended set of part kinds that share [`NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md)'s structure.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NamePartType`](gmeow-NamePartType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the kind of a name part — referenced from a [`gmeow:NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md) via [`gmeow:namePartType`](../properties/gmeow-namePartType.md), or extended with a new individual when a naming system contributes a part kind not yet seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a [`NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md) subclass for a new part kind (kinds are individuals on an open value vocabulary) and avoid forcing a culture's part into an ill-fitting Western category — add the proper individual instead.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`NamePartType`](gmeow-NamePartType.md) individual from [`gmeow:namePartType`](../properties/gmeow-namePartType.md) on a [`gmeow:NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md); extend the vocabulary by minting a new individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition) rather than a subclass.

### Examples

- ex:part [`gmeow:namePartType`](../properties/gmeow-namePartType.md) [`gmeow:namePartNisba`](../individuals/gmeow-namePartNisba.md).
